title: satureja vulgaris proles glandulosa
intro: Satureja vulgaris proles glandulosa, commonly known as Red Mountain savory or glandular savory, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae, native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as digestive issues and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Satureja vulgaris proles glandulosa include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it effective in relieving symptoms of coughs, colds, and indigestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include carvacrol, thymol, and borneol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are commonly found in the plant's essential oil.
